{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./foo.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=1, --ntasks-per-node=1 -> -N 1 -n 1
#   --gres=gpu:1                   -> -g 1
#   --time=5-13:00:00              -> -t 5d13h
#   --output=foo.txt               -> -o output=foo.txt
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 1 -g 1 -t 5d13h -o output=foo.txt --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=gpu8_long not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the gpu8_long partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem=70GB not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-type=END / --mail-user not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  module load matlab/

  module load anaconda3/cpu/5.2.0
  module load cuda90/toolkit/9.1.176
  module load cuda90/fft/9.1.176

  cd /scratch/td2201/ || exit 1

  flux run -n 1 -c 1 -g 1 python ml_is_good.py
fi
"
}
